attacks.name: Klyntar Firepower
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Bleed|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition.

attacks.name: Incendiary Grenade
steps: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§incinerate§Incinerate| special condition.

attacks.name: Symbiote Special Forces
steps: |!wild| |!hit| |*Lashing Tendrils|: After each attack is resolved, deal 1 |!damage| to each other enemy character within |!range| 2 of this character.

superPowers.name: Symbiote Web Swing
superPowers.body: Place this character within |!range| 3 of its current position. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Project Rebirth 2.0
superPowers.body: This character immediately makes a Shake action.

superPowers.name: All-Star Quarterback
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature or an enemy character, both of |!size| 3 or less and within |!range| 2, and Throw it |!range_small|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Symbiotic Instincts
superPowers.body: While this character is attacking, the defender cannot modify its defense dice.
